summary.en: Vite WGSL source hot reload; matching and lifecycle limitations are documented explicitly.
summary.zh: Vite WGSL 源码热更新，明确说明路径匹配和生命周期限制。

description.en: Create a lightweight Vite plugin that broadcasts changed .wgsl source files.
description.zh: 创建轻量 Vite 插件，广播变化后的 .wgsl 源码。

description.en: Plugin named wgpu-kit:hot-reload with a handleHotUpdate hook.
description.zh: 名为 wgpu-kit:hot-reload、含 handleHotUpdate 钩子的插件。

constraints.en: Only files ending exactly in .wgsl are handled. The hook reads source and broadcasts custom event wgpu-kit:kernel with { file, code }, then returns [] to suppress the normal module-update path for that change.
constraints.zh: 仅处理以 .wgsl 结尾的文件。钩子读取源码，通过 wgpu-kit:kernel 自定义事件发送 { file, code }，并返回 []，抑制该变更的常规模块更新路径。

constraints.en: Read/broadcast runs in an unawaited async task and has no error handler. This helper does not compile WGSL on the server.
constraints.zh: 读取/广播在未等待的异步任务中执行，没有错误处理器；该助手不在服务端编译 WGSL。

typeDetails.name: VitePluginLike (supporting, not exported)
typeDetails.type: { name: string; apply?: string; handleHotUpdate?(ctx: ViteHotUpdateCtx): unknown }

description.en: Minimal structural return type. Actual result has name and handleHotUpdate; apply is absent.
description.zh: 最小结构化返回类型。实际结果含 name 和 handleHotUpdate，不设置 apply。

typeDetails.name: ViteHotUpdateCtx (supporting, not exported)
typeDetails.type: { file: string; read(): string | Promise<string>; server: { ws: { send(payload: { type: string; event: string; data: unknown }): void } } }

description.en: Hook context: file is the changed path; read obtains source; server.ws.send publishes the custom payload.
description.zh: 钩子上下文：file 为变化路径；read 获取源码；server.ws.send 发布自定义消息。

exports.name: hotKernel
exports.signature: hotKernel(kernel: ElementKernel, hot: HotContext | undefined, file: string): void

description.en: Connect one ElementKernel to matching Vite WGSL source-change events.
description.zh: 将一个 ElementKernel 连接到匹配的 Vite WGSL 源码变更事件。

description.en: Kernel whose asynchronous replace(code) method is invoked for matching events. RawKernel is not the declared argument type.
description.zh: 匹配事件到达时调用其异步 replace(code) 的 kernel；声明参数类型不是 RawKernel。

description.en: Usually import.meta.hot. Passing undefined is an intentional no-op for production.
description.zh: 通常传 import.meta.hot；传 undefined 时什么都不做，适用于生产环境。

description.en: File suffix selector, normally ./sim.wgsl. Version 2.0.0 derives suffix with file.slice(file.lastIndexOf("/")); always include a slash.
description.zh: 文件后缀选择器，通常为 ./sim.wgsl。2.0.0 通过 file.slice(file.lastIndexOf("/")) 提取后缀；务必包含斜杠。

constraints.en: Matching uses only the suffix from the final slash, so equally named WGSL files in different directories can collide. A bare filename without slash degenerates to its final character.
constraints.zh: 只按最后一个斜杠起的后缀匹配，不同目录同名 WGSL 文件可能冲突。没有斜杠的裸文件名会退化为只取最后一个字符。

constraints.en: Compilation failure is caught and logged; ElementKernel.replace retains the working old implementation. No unsubscribe, deduplication, or HMR-dispose registration is provided, even if hot.off exists.
constraints.zh: 编译失败会被捕获并记录；ElementKernel.replace 保留可工作的旧实现。即便 hot.off 存在，也不提供取消订阅、去重或 HMR dispose 注册。

typeDetails.name: HotContext (supporting, not exported)
typeDetails.type: { on(event: string, cb: (data: unknown) => void): void; off?(event: string, cb: (data: unknown) => void): void }

description.en: on is required and registers an event listener; off is optional and unused by this implementation. Event payload is checked for string code and file.
description.zh: on 必填，用于注册事件监听；off 可选，但当前实现未调用。事件载荷须含字符串 code 和 file。

caption.en: Register the client-side kernel using a slash-containing file path.
caption.zh: 用包含斜杠的路径注册客户端 kernel。
